problem.title: Mesh-LOAM KITTI Odom seq 02 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the Mesh-LOAM reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: Mesh-LOAM paper path (0.1 m input, nearest facet) + 0.22 deg correction
variants.intent: Paper input and association: 0.1 m input (the map voxel size) without a point cap, normals from 10 NN in 0.5 m cells, the gated facet nearest to the point within the 0.2 m search interval (Sec. III-B), and the KITTI vertical-angle correction.
variants.note: Mesh-LOAM: incremental voxel-hash IMLS-SDF map with block-wise zero-surface extraction and point-to-mesh GN odometry (normal cosine gate); CV prior, no GT seed. Paper path (0.1 m input, nearest facet). nearest-facet association; mean|residual|=0.026
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
